create_cross_entropy_acc_criterion: create a CrossEntropyWithAccCriterion instance with a task and sentence_avg setting for fairseq training
compute_loss_nll: compute the negative log-likelihood loss and log-probs from model output and target tokens
get_logging_output_accuracy: get logging output with accuracy metrics including correct predictions and total tokens for a sample
forward_cross_entropy_acc: run the forward pass to compute cross entropy loss with accuracy metrics for a speech recognition sample
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training to compute average loss and token accuracy
